description: This file defines a snapshotter for capturing DOM and stylesheet states, including a class 'Streamer' that observes DOM mutations, intercepts style sheet modifications, and generates DOM snapshots with resource overrides for stylesheets. It is part of Playwright's internal tracing and snapshot recording system.

classes.name: Streamer
classes.description: A class responsible for observing DOM mutations, intercepting style sheet modifications, and capturing DOM snapshots with resource overrides.

methods.name: frameSnapshotStreamer
methods.description: Initializes the snapshot streamer, setting up mutation observers, method intercepts, and snapshot capturing logic.
